title: Explain why complete Saw feasibility requests stay RED without changing formulas, thresholds, routes, or inventory
intent: Evidence and adjudication only. Trace the canonical Saw feasibility path from repository facts through all seven calculators and record why the public verdict is RED. Do not change production formulas, thresholds, routes, persistence, or the manufacturing-output inventory. Do not contain either Saw route. Do not merge.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Added a read-only generator and a committed trace for the canonical Saw feasibility path. The generator calls compute_saw_feasibility and records per-calculator scores, metadata, the weighted sum, and one-variable sweeps. Investigation notes classify the RED verdict. A pytest module checks that the trace matches a fresh canonical evaluation and that regeneration is byte-identical. The generator and evidence test read their cited repository fixture dictionaries with ast.literal_eval instead of importing through the ambiguous top-level tests package, making full-suite collection independent of import order. No calculator, router, model, route, or inventory file is modified.
diff_articulation.why: Complete in-range Saw requests still return RED after truthful fact transport. This increment separates a correct safety result of the frozen formulas from a mapping gap and an unresolved specific-cutting-energy identity, without tuning the score.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Orders 006 and the integer fail-closed follow-up proved that submitted facts reach the calculators. They did not trace which calculator forces RED, whether the fixture is a catalogued job, or whether kc=30 J/mm3 is the same quantity as the species-file estimates. This package answers those questions from production outputs and stops at a single next decision, SAW-ENERGY-IDENTITY-008. Containment readiness is NO.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No formula, threshold, weight, material coefficient, or favourable default. Neither Saw route is contained. SawLabService.check_feasibility, the compare route, and G-code/geometry generators are untouched. The manufacturing-output inventory is not regenerated and remains at 13 LIVE_UNGOVERNED. No machine profile, blade specification, or material constant was added.
diff_articulation.representative_cases: CASE-A is not assembled: no repository machine, blade, and job record jointly supply thickness, arbor, RPM, feed, stock, power, and cut geometry. CASE-B is COMPLETE_SAW_REQUEST, a constructed authority fixture, not a production setup: RED 56.2, first gate heat, also forced by deflection and cutting_force, kc metadata 30, cutting power 112500 W, available 2550 W, power ratio 44.118. SANE_SAW via spindle_power_watts=3000 matches that verdict. CASE-C sweeps are hypothetical_sweep and all RED. CASE-D, the existing unsafe fixture, stays RED 34.3.
